recognize_zh: 骨髓 core 切片高倍可見片狀中型芽細胞，核圓形至不規則、有些有凹陷或摺痕，染色質細緻呈粉塵狀、核仁小，胞質少而淡，並有散在核分裂像；單調的芽細胞浸潤本身不具譜系特異性，需免疫染色歸類為 BPDCN。
features: Round to irregular nuclei, some indented or folded, with fine powdery chromatin
Small nucleoli in a subset of cells
Scant to moderate pale amphophilic cytoplasm with distinct cell borders in areas
Scattered mitotic figures and occasional apoptotic bodies
Few residual erythroid precursors; adipocyte at upper left
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows sheets of monotonous intermediate-sized blasts with round to irregular, occasionally indented nuclei, fine powdery chromatin, small nucleoli and scant pale cytoplasm. Mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies are scattered, and only rare residual erythroid precursors are present. No maturing granulocytes, eosinophils or megakaryocytic dysplasia are evident in this field. Findings represent marrow replacement by a blastic neoplasm, consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm when supported by CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCF4 immunostains.

ddx.vs: AML may be morphologically identical in sections and is separated by MPO, CD34 and CD117 positivity versus CD123/TCF4/TCL1 with CD56.
Lymphoblasts show similar fine chromatin and mitoses but are TdT-positive with CD19/PAX5 or CD3 expression.
Blastoid MCL expresses CD20, CD5 and cyclin D1/SOX11, which BPDCN lacks.

ddx.dx: Myeloid sarcoma or extramedullary monocytic leukemia
ddx.vs: These are lysozyme/CD68/CD163 or MPO-positive and usually CD123-dim, without TCF4 nuclear staining.
